tools.name: security-signals_event-correlate
tools.description: Correlate caller-supplied security events into related incident groups using time windows and shared actor/host/IP links. Observed grouping only—not a confirmed attack. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-signals/event-correlate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: security-signals_weak-signal-detect
tools.description: Identify early suspicious-activity indicators from caller-supplied events. Weak signals are hypotheses with explicit confidence—not confirmed attacks. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/security-signals/weak-signal-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: security-signals_attack-sequence-detect

tools.name: security-signals_insider-threat-signal-detect
